d.ko: Shiina Taki's Decameron is a doujin interactive fiction based on anime「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」. The story concentrates on Shiina Taki, the drummer and song writer of MyGO!!!!! and her fight against fate till the last breath.
d.en: Shiina Taki's Decameron is a doujin interactive fiction based on anime「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」. The story concentrates on Shiina Taki, the drummer and song writer of MyGO!!!!! and her fight against fate till the last breath.
d.zh: 基于原作动画「BanG Dream! It's MyGO!!!!!」，以鼓手「椎名立希」为主角的同人互动小说。

rv.t: 优秀的同人作品，这才是我想看的少女乐队，而不是一堆精神病化身自爆卡车互相攻击
满分5分我会给4.5分，一分扣在等了太久，为什么算法超了5分，因为这是完美以上的作品
